classification: INHERIT with explicitly named local exceptions
title: Actual acquisition and paid commitment
wording: All five use their complete native classAccess row: actual class level, school, rank and base RP; no total-level, discounted-price or same-name substitution grants access. V requires real audible speech, S a usable hand or a real exception, F the actual focus; source-authorized exemptions retain only their scope. An illegal uncommitted declaration spends nothing. A legal commitment spends its real Action/Bonus Action/Reaction permission, actual final RP/material/HP/charge price, components and source-use ledgers once, sets any prospective concentration and ends incompatible old concentration before interruption, then updates actual chronological casting-family, Dissonance/Refrain and beginning hooks before its Counterspell window. Ordinary success, failure, countering and later ineligibility refund nothing. A resumed parent never overwrites an intervening Reaction cast's later history. Save DC and attacks use the actual generating class and acquired automatic features. All preparation-bound identities, modes, timestamps and costs are recorded before their window; ordinary Ready's target/area selection occurs at legal release, without another payment or counter window. No spell here grants its required anatomy, inventory, repertoire, proficiency, extra Action or physical support.

classification: INHERIT plus explicit per-spell clock registrations
title: Markers, life and idempotent event history
wording: Bind absolute time and source/recipient original regular START/END markers separately. A future target END excludes an already-underway target turn; a source next START means its first future original regular START. Preserve that clock through reordering, absence, suppression and initiative changes under the accepted virtual-marker rule; outside-initiative one-round registrations use the specified original elapsed six seconds, never a reset on entering initiative. Expire START-ending effects before refresh; then actual Reaction/recharge, legal already-due life recovery, death save, other required START events and only then voluntary decisions. END damage/saves/maintenance precede END-expiry. A resolved marker/event cannot be repeated. A real full Action grant retains its original cap and recursive-grant restriction. No new generic timeline, Time Loop restoration, world rewind, turn duplication or source reset is selected. Every fixture explicitly supplies its schedule and ordinary-round identity; elapsed seconds alone are not a universal round-number formula.

classification: NEW LOCAL common wording only for Absolute Zero and Chrono Lock
title: Finite body suspension, not generic Incapacitated
wording:
When one of these two spells actually establishes its suspension, the same active creature is unaware, cannot speak, choose voluntary behavior, act, use Bonus Actions/Reactions, move, command or perform voluntary upkeep. Hold the actual body and currently worn/carried inanimate equipment at its current pose. Other carried/mounted creatures are not suspended by association. Existing external supports can break; ordinary gravity, forced movement and ordinary teleportation cannot relocate the held body while operative. A source explicitly overriding this suspension remains an exact exception. No attack advantage, automatic STR/DEX failure, adjacent critical, Prone, Stunned or generic Incapacitated is implied.
The held body/gear admits no new bodily damage, healing, temporary HP, conditions, direct HP loss, transformation or physical alteration. An otherwise legal paid attempt may resolve no bodily payload; nothing is banked. Distinguish genuine damage prevention from loss of source eligibility. Every actual due periodic opportunity is consumed once even when its bodily payload is prevented; independent source clocks, END saves for an existing source, scheduled source cleanup, mandatory form ending and world state continue. A mandatory anatomy ending can become a pending body-normalization consequence until interaction resumes; it never resets that source's timer or grants a new form.
Death saves due during operative suspension are marked skipped without a roll, success or failure and cannot be rerolled for that same regular marker later. Absolute Stable recovery remains its ORIGINAL due deadline: while HP gain is blocked keep a due-blocked record, not a new d4 or renewed delay. After suspension, the first genuine legal recovery checkpoint under the existing life/START ordering resolves that original opportunity once. No new recovery is granted by this spell. Explicit world-timed lethal tracks and their real death rules continue: a genuine lethal track transition can kill despite prevented damage/HP change, and true death/removal ends this application. Immediate biological aging, respiration expenditure and metabolism pause; elapsed world calendars, actual deprivation/debt/history continue, and there is no food, water, rest, work, study or recovery credit.
Existing concentration is not lost merely because this is not Incapacitated. Actual deadline, source dependency, unpaid upkeep, death or another real ending still ends it. Body-emitted aura/technique output and optional command/control are unavailable while held; completed independent fields/projectiles and other bodies retain their actual sources. Missed emissions do not queue. A required further personal action cannot complete; a completely committed independent effect resolves only if its own continuing predicates remain.
The temporal application remains a real rank-six removable/suppressible effect at the actual body. Eligible removal requires its real source target/range/perception or actual area-capture interface; no hidden locator is granted. Actual suppression restores ordinary interaction while the original deadline and hard-admission record continue. Resumption before that deadline captures the same surviving active identity at its CURRENT real pose, not its old position; it heals nothing, resets nothing and never spends another hard guard. An actually ended/dead/removed source cannot resume. On final ending real unsupported height uses the existing Falling marker. No detachable ice, material stock, stored-damage burst, native-plane or soul claim is created.

title: Actual witnesses and bodies
wording: Use actual occupied bodies, perception and source-qualified line of effect; another actor's ally status does not make its body transparent. Cases declare Medium5x5x6 occupied boxes with x/y foot center and z bottom only as synthetic physical inputs. A direct creature range uses the ordinary occupied-body distance and an actual clear witness; point spells use one real selected caster point to that declared point. Fireball keeps literal20-foot cast range and20-foot radius. A declared path/witness is not proof of an unauthenticated campaign collider. Time Skip's return uses same-anchor, legal squeeze, then only an actually reachable nearest adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, stable minimum-displacement/overlap/neutral order. With none, absence still ends into an explicit returned-placement conflict, not further invulnerability, remote teleportation, crushing damage or a new body. Permanent gear/corpse identity and actual custody are conserved.

classification: INHERIT; Contingency-specific new checkpoint stated in its procedure
title: Actual life operations and original source ownership
wording: Do not merge normal damage, HP costs, ordinary healing, direct recovery, stabilization, temporary HP and resurrection. Actual instant death, Wounds, Critical, independent conditions and recipient gates resolve in their source order. Immunity to one damage type is not immunity to suspension. Null retains its real original-dealer root-creation snapshot and exceptions; a controller, bound recipient, redirect recipient or callback is not a replacement dealer. Only an actual source grants a new root, reflection, secondary healing or resource event. These procedures introduce no sixth Fate/information presentation, revive no spent entitlement and do not authenticate synthetic source facts. The accepted Grave Gift direct-recovery and independent stabilization/False Life gates remain exact.

classification: INHERIT; NEW local finite receipt schema
title: Durable local entitlements
wording: Record cast ID, selected grant, paid base/extra/HP values, targets/modes, real commitment and outcome times, immutable clocks, interruption stack, source/recipient identity and consumed slot/attempt histories. Local hard-control keys are original caster/target/genuine encounter, shared with that character's actual whole-Action denial. Only actual establishment spends that guard. Local Time Skip bonus and Contingency release ledgers are separate permissions, not encounter resets, general Action-grant ledgers or copied-feat allowances. Save/reload and duplicate callbacks preserve receipts. A new application ID cannot launder a prior original-source entitlement; callback ID is never a payment/recovery key. Runtime atomicity remains an implementation obligation, not proved by authoring these finite records.
